How to get it :
- Crafting table : 3 x Zirconium Splinter, 2 x Plutonium-241 Nugget, Reactor Grade Americium Nugget.
- Crafting table (x6) : 3 x Zirconium Billet, 2 x Plutonium-241 Billet, Reactor Grade Americium Billet.

Used to make :
[[gv:rbmk_fuel_zfb_am_mix|Fuel Grade Americium RBMK ZFB Rod]].
